name: get_selected_object_motion_id

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GetSelectedObjectMotionId increments Script stackTop and, when the selected object pointer at Script offset 0x04 is non-null, pushes the object's motion ID from offset 0x164

notes: func_00130788 copies the low 16-bit motion request at object offset 0x17C into offset 0x164, and func_00130098 maps that motion ID through the object's motion table before animation setup; offsets 0x168 and 0x16C hold the resulting animation ID and frame. A null selected-object pointer leaves the newly exposed stack slot unchanged. All six JP calls are copies of the same pc06.ard entry structure and immediately store the result in scenario variable 2572.
